verdict.rationale: The API reference explicitly offers a downloadable OpenAPI contract at /contracts/openapi.json with request and response schemas. Hands-on probes confirm the CLI prints the hosted API's full input JSON Schemas (2020-12) with no login. The probe's 404s were on conventional paths (/openapi.json, /swagger.json, etc.), not the documented /contracts path, so they do not contradict the claim, though they do lower discoverability. Missing for 10: a hands-on fetch confirming /contracts/openapi.json resolves and is complete, the spec being served at conventional or well-known discovery paths, and independent corroboration. [2026-10-08 adversarial bias audit (owner-product bring-up lane): reverted full 7 -> partial 3 — the story object is a retrievable machine-readable spec; the documented download path https://api.ultrametric.ai/contracts/openapi.json answers 404 on the 2026-10-08 audit fetch, and every conventional path 404d in the recorded probe. What survives hands-on is `context schema open|save|get` printing JSON Schema 2020-12 input contracts keylessly — machine-readable contracts, not a retrievable OpenAPI document. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
